sales_backpressure_enabled.summary: Throttle how many orders a shopper can place in a short window.
sales_backpressure_enabled.usage: Guards checkout against bursts of order attempts — bots, double-clicks, or abuse. When Yes, order placement is rate-limited per shopper using the limits below. When No, no limit is applied.

sales_backpressure_guest_limit.summary: Maximum order attempts a single guest may make per period.
sales_backpressure_guest_limit.usage: The number of order-placement requests allowed from one guest within each counter window (set by Counter resets in a…). Guests are identified by IP address.

sales_backpressure_limit.summary: Maximum order attempts a signed-in customer may make per period.
sales_backpressure_limit.usage: The number of order-placement requests allowed from one authenticated customer within each counter window.

sales_backpressure_period.summary: The window over which order-placement attempts are counted.
sales_backpressure_period.usage: How often the rate-limit counter resets. A shorter window allows fewer attempts before the limit takes effect.

sales_cancellation_enabled.summary: Let customers cancel their own orders through the GraphQL API.
sales_cancellation_enabled.usage: When Yes, storefront (headless / PWA) customers can cancel eligible orders through GraphQL, choosing one of the reasons below. When No, self-service cancellation is off.

sales_cancellation_reasons.summary: The list of reasons a customer can pick when cancelling an order.
sales_cancellation_reasons.usage: Defines the selectable cancellation reasons offered to customers when they cancel an order from the storefront.

sales_dashboard_use_aggregated_data.summary: Use pre-aggregated statistics for the admin dashboard charts.
sales_dashboard_use_aggregated_data.usage: When Yes, the dashboard reads from aggregated report tables — much faster, but the figures are only as fresh as the last statistics refresh. When No, it queries live data, which is accurate but slower on large stores.

sales_general_hide_customer_ip.summary: Hide the customer's IP address on order documents.
sales_general_hide_customer_ip.usage: When Yes, the customer IP is not shown on orders, invoices, shipments or credit memos — useful for privacy and GDPR. When No, the IP is recorded and visible to admins.

sales_gift_options_allow_items.summary: Let shoppers add a gift message to individual order items.
sales_gift_options_allow_items.usage: When Yes, customers can attach a gift message to each item in the order.

sales_gift_options_allow_order.summary: Let shoppers add a single gift message to the whole order.
sales_gift_options_allow_order.usage: When Yes, customers can attach one gift message that covers the entire order.

sales_identity_address.summary: The store address printed on invoices, shipments and credit memos.
sales_identity_address.usage: The address block shown on PDF and HTML sales documents. Leave blank to omit it.

sales_identity_logo.summary: The logo printed on PDF sales documents.
sales_identity_logo.usage: The logo used on PDF invoices, shipments and credit memos. Accepts JPEG, TIFF or PNG; use a high-resolution image for crisp print output.

sales_identity_logo_html.summary: The logo shown on the HTML (on-screen) print view.
sales_identity_logo_html.usage: The logo used for the HTML print view only. If left empty, the PDF logo is used. Accepts JPEG, GIF or PNG.

sales_instant_purchase_active.summary: Offer one-click Instant Purchase using a stored payment method.
sales_instant_purchase_active.usage: When Yes, customers with a saved (vaulted) payment method and address see an Instant Purchase button that places the order in a single step. Requires a payment method that supports vault and instant purchase.

sales_instant_purchase_button_text.summary: The label shown on the Instant Purchase button.
sales_instant_purchase_button_text.usage: The call-to-action text for the Instant Purchase button on the storefront.

sales_minimum_order_active.summary: Require orders to reach a minimum amount before checkout.
sales_minimum_order_active.usage: When Yes, customers cannot place an order below the Minimum Amount set below.

sales_minimum_order_amount.summary: The smallest order value a customer may check out with.
sales_minimum_order_amount.usage: The minimum order value required to place an order, measured as the subtotal after discount. Applies only when the minimum-order rule is enabled.

sales_minimum_order_description.summary: The cart message shown while an order is below the minimum.
sales_minimum_order_description.usage: Shown in the shopping cart when the subtotal is still below the minimum, prompting the shopper to add more.

sales_minimum_order_error_message.summary: The error shown when a below-minimum order is attempted.
sales_minimum_order_error_message.usage: The message displayed in the cart when a customer tries to proceed with an order under the minimum.

sales_minimum_order_include_discount_amo.summary: Measure the minimum against the subtotal after discounts.
sales_minimum_order_include_discount_amo.usage: When Yes, the minimum is checked against the subtotal after discounts. When No, it is checked against the subtotal before discounts.

sales_minimum_order_multi_address.summary: Apply the minimum to each address in multi-address checkout.
sales_minimum_order_multi_address.usage: When Yes, each shipping address in a multi-address order must meet the minimum on its own. When No, the minimum applies to the order as a whole.

sales_minimum_order_multi_address_descri.summary: The cart message for below-minimum multi-address orders.
sales_minimum_order_multi_address_descri.usage: Shown in the cart for multi-address checkout when an address is below the minimum. Leave empty to reuse the standard description above.

sales_minimum_order_multi_address_error_.summary: The error for below-minimum multi-address orders.
sales_minimum_order_multi_address_error_.usage: The error shown for multi-address checkout when an address is below the minimum. Leave empty to reuse the standard error above.

sales_minimum_order_tax_including.summary: Count tax toward the minimum order amount.
sales_minimum_order_tax_including.usage: When Yes, tax is included when checking the minimum order amount. When No, only the pre-tax subtotal counts.

sales_msrp_display_price_type.summary: When to reveal the actual price on products that use MAP.
sales_msrp_display_price_type.usage: Controls where a product's real price appears when Minimum Advertised Price hides it — on a shopper gesture, once it is in the cart, or just before order confirmation.

sales_msrp_enabled.summary: Turn on Minimum Advertised Price handling store-wide.
sales_msrp_enabled.usage: When Yes, products can hide their price under MAP rules and reveal it later. Warning: enabling MAP by default hides every storefront price until each product is configured.

sales_msrp_explanation_message.summary: The popup text explaining why a price is hidden.
sales_msrp_explanation_message.usage: The message shown in the MAP popup that explains why the price is not displayed.

sales_msrp_explanation_message_whats_thi.summary: The text behind the MAP "What's this?" link.
sales_msrp_explanation_message_whats_thi.usage: The explanatory text revealed by the What's this? link next to a MAP-hidden price.

sales_orders_delete_pending_after.summary: How long an unpaid pending order survives before cancellation.
sales_orders_delete_pending_after.usage: The number of minutes a pending-payment order is kept before the cron job cancels it and releases its reserved stock.

sales_reorder_allow.summary: Let customers reorder a past order from their account.
sales_reorder_allow.usage: When Yes, a Reorder button appears in the customer account, adding a previous order's items back to the cart.

sales_totals_sort_subtotal.summary: The position of the Subtotal line in the totals block.
sales_totals_sort_subtotal.usage: Sort order of the Subtotal row among the cart and checkout totals. Lower numbers appear higher in the list.

sales_totals_sort_discount.summary: The position of the Discount line in the totals block.
sales_totals_sort_discount.usage: Sort order of the Discount row among the totals. Lower numbers appear higher in the list.

sales_totals_sort_shipping.summary: The position of the Shipping line in the totals block.
sales_totals_sort_shipping.usage: Sort order of the Shipping row among the totals. Lower numbers appear higher in the list.

sales_totals_sort_tax.summary: The position of the Tax line in the totals block.
sales_totals_sort_tax.usage: Sort order of the Tax row among the totals. Lower numbers appear higher in the list.

sales_totals_sort_weee.summary: The position of the Fixed Product Tax line in the totals block.
sales_totals_sort_weee.usage: Sort order of the Fixed Product Tax (FPT / WEEE) row among the totals. Lower numbers appear higher in the list.

sales_totals_sort_grand_total.summary: The position of the Grand Total line in the totals block.
sales_totals_sort_grand_total.usage: Sort order of the Grand Total row among the totals. Lower numbers appear higher in the list.

sales_zerograndtotal_creditmemo_allow_ze.summary: Allow credit memos whose total is zero.
sales_zerograndtotal_creditmemo_allow_ze.usage: When Yes, a credit memo can be created even when its total is zero — for example when refunding only non-monetary items. When No, zero-total credit memos are blocked.
